signin_desc: Sign in to manage your feeder.
loading_status_desc: Checking the service and your access settings before opening the feeder.
startup_status_desc: Model loading and hardware checks can take longer after an update or model change. This progress comes directly from the container.
startup_failed_desc: Startup stopped during a required check. Your feeder data is safe; check the container logs for the cause.
startup_phase_loading_model: Loading and checking the selected bird model
startup_phase_model_unavailable: Classifier unavailable: setup can continue after the backend starts
status_unavailable_desc: The service may still be starting after an update or model change. Your feeder data is safe while it comes back online.
status_unavailable_auto_retry: YA-WAMF checks again automatically every five seconds.
status_unavailable_help: If it stays offline, check the container health and startup logs.
login_failed: Could not sign in. Check your username and password.

password_policy.requirements: At least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one number. No more than 72 bytes: accented and non-Latin letters take more than one.
password_policy.too_short: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
password_policy.too_long: The password must use 72 bytes or fewer. Accented and non-Latin letters take more than one byte.
password_policy.needs_letter_and_number: The password must contain at least one letter and one number.
password_policy.required: Enter a password to turn on authentication.
